name: The Fight arena, made for Allworld
author: Allworld

want.note: The Fight stage at the rules' own scale (1.8 m fighters, 15.8 m between the walls): a 16.5 m ring on a concrete floor; colour and ambient occlusion baked into one 1024 px atlas.
Fight clips for the native 53-joint characters (idle, walk, jab, cross, kick, block, hits, down, cheer), keyframed from code; animations only, no mesh.
